comparison_scope: q4 and q8 are separate capacity conditions. Joint-minus-constant estimates the training outcome of input-conditioned versus static bounded mixing under the specified parameterization; it does not isolate retrieval mechanisms. Candidate-minus-original includes both added capacity and mixing. Channel and query variants have different parameter counts and compute.
conditioning_compute_scope: Joint and constant have identical A/B shapes and trainable parameter counts within granularity. Constant skips three LayerNorm operations; exactly equal FLOPs are not claimed.

constant_input_design.values: alternating +1,-1; fixed nontrainable buffer shared across samples and query slots
constant_input_design.revision: Pretraining design revision from the earlier unit-L2 analysis-plan draft to RMS1 matching the scale of concatenated functional LayerNorm inputs; not an optimizer or learning-rate change.
constant_input_design.compute_scope: Joint and constant retain identical A/B shapes and trainable parameter counts within granularity. Constant may omit LayerNorm preprocessing; equal FLOPs are not claimed.

optimizer_compatibility: Only a finite, exactly matched second-step A initialization may bypass HeavyBall's false allclose-zero rejection; the computed automatic scale remains exactly unchanged
